LoginSession.title: LoginSession
LoginSession.description: Consented client VIP key login record containing verified IP address and device metadata.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the authenticated client.

userEmail.description: Verified email address of the authenticated client.

activationKey.description: VIP activation key used to unlock the overlay.

ipAddress.description: Device IP address shared after explicit user consent.

hardwareId.description: Client device architecture and hardware identifier.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when session was recorded (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when session was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/login_sessions/{sessionId}.description: Consented VIP key login sessions visible to the owning user and verified admin.
